summary: Lenny Rachitsky writes a widely read product and growth newsletter, hosts a podcast and, according to his website, actively angel invests in AI, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, platforms and remarkable consumer products. The investing page states these focus areas but the individual portfolio, check size, stage, geography and a pitch route are not readable on the pages reviewed, so a match can only be assessed on sector. No personal address is collected for this person profile.

investmentEvidence.fact: The investing page states active angel investing in the listed categories; individual companies are not readable without JavaScript on the pages reviewed.
